evidence.title: Favicon Generator for perfect icons on all browsers

name: RealFaviconGenerator
summary: Favicon generator that produces icons and HTML markup for every browser, platform and device, plus a favicon checker.
description: Drop an image and get a favicon package: SVG and PNG favicons, Apple touch icons, Android and web app manifest icons, plus the HTML markup and setup instructions. Instant previews show how the icon looks in browser tabs, on home screens and in Google result pages. A free checker audits live sites, and guides plus integration pages cover React, Next.js, Rails, Node CLI, Gulp, Grunt and ASP.NET Core.
contains: one image in, icons for desktop browsers, iOS, Android and search results out
output: SVG and PNG favicons, favicon.ico, Apple touch icons, HTML markup and setup instructions
instant preview of the icon on each platform
free favicon checker with more than a dozen checks for live sites
reference guides on favicon formats and platforms
integration pages: React, Next.js, Rails, Node, Node CLI, Gulp, Grunt, ASP.NET Core
